method: Hand-derived from the pinned source rules named in provenance; no F1 hydrate, project or serializer output was observed or used.
rule: Closed union across both runtimes. A listed name is refused with reserved-name before native construction when it arrives as a foreign attribute/property (XML attribute, JSON $attrs key, or a JSON member outside its schema-owned position). Schema-owned positions remain allowed: $type as element discriminator, $name/$attrs/$body/$children on a generic element, $attrs as the attribute map itself.
derivation: Wire fields from the plan wire model; JS members from the native element factory and generic-element construction (type/attrs/parent/descriptor/model/instance accessors); twin slots and methods from the step-1 note enumeration plus the generic element class surface read in source; prototype hooks are the standard object-prototype names whose assignment would shadow or pollute. Names starting with $ are not XML names and have no XML vector; every listed name has the JSON $attrs vector behaviour defined in 01-reserved-names.json.
